title: E0039: Property Access on Null
plain_english: Reports property reads on values that can be null.
why_matters: Reading a property on `null` causes a fatal runtime error. This rule uses Phanalist's bounded formal verification engine (Z3-backed) to detect feasible paths where the receiver can be null.
bad_example:
<?php
function id(?User $user): int
{
    return $user->id; // $user may be null
}
good_example:
<?php
function id(?User $user): int
{
    if ($user === null) {
        return 0;
    }

    return $user->id;
}
what_it_checks: Property reads on null and nullable values
Nullness narrowed by `if`, `switch`, `match`, `isset()`, and short-circuit conditions
Nullsafe property access (`?->`) is treated as safe
